_note: B-SAFE. Saved-note lines use the privacy wording from #240 (drafts/planning/BETA-privacy-page.md, 'The short version'). If that page changes, change these too.
savedNoteLines: Your child's progress is saved only on your device.
We don't collect any personal information from the game.
There are no accounts, no ads, no purchases, no chat and no tracking tools.
wipeTitle: Erase all progress on this phone?
wipeHelp: This removes the dojo, belt, gear and settings. It can't be undone. The game starts fresh.
